skill.name: subagent-driven-development
skill.description: Coordinate implementation plan execution by dispatching fresh subagents for each independent task, then requiring spec compliance and code quality reviews.
skill.summary: Runs independent implementation tasks through implementer, spec reviewer, and code quality reviewer subagents.

content.value_statement: Independent implementation tasks can lose quality when context and review steps are inconsistent. This skill supplies a repeatable subagent workflow with implementer, spec review, and code quality checkpoints.
actual_capabilities: Guides extraction of independent tasks from an implementation plan.
Provides an implementer subagent prompt with testing, commit, and self-review steps.
Provides a spec compliance reviewer prompt for checking requirements against code.
Provides a code quality reviewer handoff template after spec compliance passes.
Defines review loops before each task is marked complete.
limitations: Requires an environment that supports subagents or a Task-style delegation tool.
Works best when tasks are mostly independent and can be handled sequentially.
Does not provide project-specific implementation details, commands, or test strategies.
Uses more agent calls because each task receives multiple review passes.

use_cases.title: Execute planned feature work
use_cases.description: Run a prepared feature plan through implementer and reviewer subagents without changing sessions.

use_cases.title: Enforce specification compliance
use_cases.description: Check that delivered code matches the task requirements before quality review begins.

use_cases.title: Structure AI coding delegation
use_cases.description: Give coding agents clear handoffs, review gates, and completion rules for multi-task changes.

prompt_templates.title: Start a small plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner workflow for two or three independent tasks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use subagent-driven development for this plan. Extract each task, create a task list, and start with the first implementer subagent.

prompt_templates.title: Run one task with review
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate workflow for a single planned task.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the implementer prompt for Task 1. After completion, run the spec compliance reviewer, then the code quality reviewer if spec review passes.

prompt_templates.title: Repair spec gaps
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow when the spec reviewer finds missing or extra work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Send the spec reviewer findings back to the same implementer subagent. Re-run spec review after fixes before starting quality review.

prompt_templates.title: Complete a multi-task branch
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for finishing all planned tasks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Continue the subagent-driven workflow for every remaining task. After all task reviews pass, run a final full implementation review.

output_examples.input: A five-task feature plan with mostly independent tasks.
output_examples.output: A task list, per-task implementer handoffs, spec review results, quality review results, and a final readiness check.

output_examples.input: A task where the implementer added an unrequested option.
output_examples.output: A spec review report naming the extra work, a fix request, a re-review result, and then a quality review handoff.

output_examples.input: A task where quality review finds a maintainability issue.
output_examples.output: A focused fix request to the implementer, a second quality review, and completion only after approval.

best_practices: Paste the full task text into each implementer prompt instead of sending agents to read the whole plan.
Run spec compliance review before code quality review for every task.
Keep review loops open until the reviewer confirms the issue is fixed.
anti_patterns: Dispatching multiple implementation subagents in parallel on the same codebase.
Skipping spec review because the implementer report sounds complete.
Starting the next task while review issues remain unresolved.

faq.question: What does this skill coordinate?
faq.answer: It coordinates implementer, spec reviewer, and code quality reviewer subagents for independent implementation tasks.

faq.question: Does it write code by itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow instructions and prompt templates for agents that perform the implementation and reviews.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it when you have an implementation plan with tasks that can be completed one at a time.

faq.question: When should I avoid it?
faq.answer: Avoid it when tasks are tightly coupled or when you need a planning discussion before implementation starts.

faq.question: Why are there two review stages?
faq.answer: Spec review checks that the requested work was done. Quality review checks maintainability after the scope is correct.

faq.question: Can this work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow is written as prompt guidance for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code style agent delegation.
